and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man…
Jehoiada made a covenant between himself, all the people, and the king, that they should be Yahweh’s people.

Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made…

This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
The king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments…
Notwithstanding, Yahweh didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Yahweh, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
translations.bsb: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that His fierce anger will turn away from us.
translations.kjv: Now it is in mine heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that his fierce wrath may turn away from us.
translations.asv: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with Jehovah, the God of Israel, that his fierce anger may turn away from us.
